title: Mother's apparition in the kitchen

tellings.quote: talked about it our mama was standing in that kitchen in a lightning storm

plain: In Tampa, Florida, during a lightning storm, the family's mother was seen standing in the kitchen, as an apparition. That is how Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site, describes it to Michels as something he lived through, and he says the family talked about it among themselves. He gives no date and says little more than that she was 'standing in that kitchen in a lightning storm.'
